source.title: Jobs and Skills Australia, Our Gen AI Transition (Generative AI Capacity Study), interactive tables data pack
source.note: Task-based scores from 0 to 1 for how much of an occupation's work Gen AI could automate (do) or augment (help with), assuming it is fully adopted. JSA does not set high, medium or low thresholds; Bcome splits occupations into thirds by score. JSA's modelling looks at adoption to 2035 and 2050.
